page_title: VLL 0-3 RMA | Valladolid v Real Madrid 25/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.
90+4' Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) receives a pass and fires a shot in from long range, but it's blocked.
90+2' A substitution has been made. Federico Valverde is replaced by Lorenzo (Real Madrid).
90+2' Carlo Ancelotti has decided to make a change. Endrick (Real Madrid) replaces Kylian Mbappe.
90+1' 0 - 3 Goal! Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Karl Hein into left side of the goal.
90+1' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
90' RED CARD! Mario Martin (Valladolid) makes a bad challenge and receives a second yellow card from Mateo Busquets. He can have an early bath.
90' Here comes the VAR decision. YES, it's a penalty!
89' Referee Mateo Busquets makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Real Madrid. Let’s see what happens!
88' PENALTY APPEAL by Real Madrid, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
86' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mamadou Sylla leaves the pitch and Chuki (Valladolid) comes on.
85' What a huge chance for Luka Modric (Real Madrid). He collects a precise pass inside the box and slices a shot that goes a whisker wide of the left post.
83' Real Madrid take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
79' The resulting corner from Luka Modric (Real Madrid) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
79' Today's match ends for Marcos Andre who will be replaced by Juanmi Latasa (Valladolid).
76' Flag goes up against Anuar (Valladolid) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
73' Carlo Ancelotti has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Arda Guler (Real Madrid) replacing Rodrygo.
72' The attendance is 26025.
70' Real Madrid hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
68' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Raul Asencio trots off the pitch and is replaced by David Alaba (Real Madrid).
68' Carlo Ancelotti has decided to substitute Dani Ceballos and he is replaced by Luka Modric (Real Madrid).

66' What a chance that is! Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the left post.
63' Mateo Busquets blows his whistle for a foul after Raul Asencio (Real Madrid) hacks down one of his opponents.
63' Raul Asencio (Real Madrid) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
62' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Real Madrid.
62' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Ivan Sanchez walks off the pitch to be replaced by Kike Perez (Valladolid).

62' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Real Madrid.
59' Mateo Busquets blows his whistle. Dani Ceballos (Real Madrid) commits a foul after dangerous play.
57' 0 - 2 Goal - 0:2! Rodrygo tees up Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) inside the box and he rolls the ball into the bottom right corner and past Karl Hein.
55' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) is penalised.
54' Real Madrid are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
51' Raul Asencio (Real Madrid) tackles a bit over-zealously and Mateo Busquets blows for a foul.
47' Today's referee Mateo Busquets rightly decides to book Dani Ceballos (Real Madrid) for his harsh tackle.
46' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) is adjudged offside.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Selim Amallah (Valladolid) is awarded a yellow card for his behaviour.
45+2' The expression of the referee Mateo Busquets is crystal clear. This behaviour won't be tolerated. Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) is shown a yellow card.
45+1' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
45' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) swings in a cross from the corner, but Karl Hein reads it well and gathers the ball.

44' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) picks up a loose pass and unexpectedly unleashes a howitzer from distance, but the effort comes to nothing as a defender gets in the block. The ball is out of play. Real Madrid win a corner kick.
41' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
40' Corner kicks – 1:3.
37' Raul Asencio (Real Madrid) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar.
35' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) is caught offside!
32' Mamadou Sylla (Valladolid) commits a rough challenge and Mateo Busquets blows his whistle for an infringement.
30' 0 - 1 Goal! Jude Bellingham provides Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a precise effort into the bottom right corner. 0:1.
29' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) takes a wild swing at a rebound from mid-range and it goes well wide of the right post.

26' Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the resulting corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly over the crossbar.
26' Real Madrid will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
25' Antonio Rudiger (Real Madrid) picks up a sweet pass and fires one in from distance towards the bottom right corner, but Karl Hein is alert and makes a decent save.

24' Mamadou Sylla (Valladolid) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike to the bottom left corner. Thibaut Courtois pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill.
22' Javier Sanchez (Valladolid) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
21' Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Mateo Busquets blows his whistle for a foul.
18' Marcos Andre (Valladolid) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
15' Mario Martin (Valladolid) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Mateo Busquets didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
14' Dani Ceballos (Real Madrid) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
12' A quickly taken corner by Real Madrid.
11' The resulting set piece from Real Madrid is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
10' The defensive wall does its job and blocks the mid-range attempt from the free-kick by Rodrygo (Real Madrid). The ball is out of play. Real Madrid will have a chance to score from a corner.
10' Anuar (Valladolid) commits a rough foul. Mateo Busquets stops the game and makes a call. Real Madrid earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
9' Mamadou Sylla (Valladolid) is penalised for holding. Mateo Busquets signals a set piece.
7' Selim Amallah (Valladolid) makes a strong challenge and Mateo Busquets blows for a foul.
6' Some neat passing and movement from Real Madrid as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
4' My Gran could have done better! Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) got himself in a great position on the edge of the box after a pass, but put his shot well wide of the left post.

3' Javier Sanchez (Valladolid) finds himself some space to meet a beautiful cross from the free kick, and from near the penalty spot he attempts to score with a header. His effort lacks accuracy and goes well wide of the right post.
3' Fran Garcia (Real Madrid) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Mateo Busquets signals.
2' David Torres (Valladolid) jumps inside the box to meet the corner and aims a low header towards middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper shows his reflexes to stop the effort.
2' The ball goes out for a corner. Valladolid can continue in their attacking effort.
2' Mamadou Sylla (Valladolid) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Valladolid will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Mateo Busquets.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
